title: AND Logic Gate (IC 7408)
summary: An AND gate is a fundamental digital logic gate that implements logical conjunction (Y = A · B). The output is HIGH (1) IF AND ONLY IF all of its inputs are HIGH (1).

working_principle: When inputs A and B are both connected to +5V (Logic 1), the internal TTL multi-emitter transistor drives the output pin to +5V (Logic 1). If either input is grounded (0V), the output is pulled down to 0V (Logic 0).
mnemonic_trick: AND is ALL! Output is 1 ONLY when ALL inputs are 1. If any input is 0, the output is ZERO!
applications: Enable/Disable Control Lines in Digital Systems
Address Decoding in Computer Memory Systems
Safety Interlock Circuits (Both conditions must be met to trigger action)
advantages: Simple implementation using standard TTL IC 7408
High noise margin in standard 5V logic
disadvantages: Cannot be used as a universal gate by itself without inverters
common_mistakes: Leaving unused input pins floating (unconnected) which TTL reads as HIGH.
Confusing AND gate symbol with OR gate symbol.
quick_notes: Pin 14 is VCC (+5V), Pin 7 is GND.

viva_questions.q: What is the IC number for a Quad 2-input AND gate?
What happens to the output of an AND gate if one input is 0 and the other is floating in TTL?
viva_questions.a: Output remains 0, because floating input is 1 but 0 · 1 = 0.

interview_questions.q: How can you implement an AND gate using only NAND gates?
interview_questions.a: Connect a 2-input NAND gate (7400) followed by a NAND gate configured as a NOT inverter.
